# HyperSpy

> HyperSpy is an open source Python library for the interactive analysis of multidimensional datasets that can be described as multidimensional arrays of a given signal (e.g., a 2D array of spectra, also known as spectrum image). It provides tools for processing, analyzing, and visualizing data from electron microscopy, spectroscopy, and related experimental techniques.

HyperSpy makes it straightforward to apply analytical procedures that operate on an individual signal to multidimensional arrays, while providing easy access to analytical tools that exploit the multidimensionality of the dataset. The library's modular structure makes it easy to add features to analyze many different types of signals.

Key features include:
- Support for multidimensional signal processing
- Interactive data visualization and exploration
- Machine learning tools (PCA, ICA, NMF)
- Model fitting and curve fitting capabilities
- Extensive I/O support for various file formats
- Integration with the scientific Python ecosystem (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Dask)

HyperSpy is particularly suited for analyzing data from:
- Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS)
- Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX/EDS)
- Cathodoluminescence (CL)
- Photoluminescence (PL)
- Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD)
- Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM)
